name: SoulCut v0.5.0 Release
body:
# 🎉 SoulCut Video Editing System v0.5.0 Official Release 🎉

> **Making Natural Language the First Interface for Video Creation**

SoulCut LLM Video Editing System is officially released! This is an AI-native video editing tool powered by our self-developed **SoulCut Engine**, which uses LLM as the interpretation layer for editing logic, allowing you to fully create videos through conversation.

## Highlights

- **SoulCut Engine** — Intelligent editing scheduling engine supporting ReAct / Batch / Chain / PlanAndExecute workflows
- **Conversational Editing** — Describe your editing intent in natural language, and it automatically handles rough cuts, fine cuts, and rhythm alignment
- **Multi-Track Timeline** — Multi-track editing with real-time preview and precise time alignment
- **Filters · Effects · Camera Motion · Transitions** — 15 filters, 78 visual effects, 15 camera motion effects, 26 transitions
- **Audio Processing** — Noise reduction, music recommendations, beat-synced editing, and automatic volume balancing
- **One-Click Export** — Supports multiple resolutions and platform presets
